capabilities: Insert mention links via a trigger-character suggester matching notes, aliases, and stub headings
Store unresolved mentions as headings in a shared stub file
Promote a stub heading to a full note, optionally applying a template
Rewrite vault-wide links when promoting or converting mentions
Bulk-convert all unresolved links in the vault to lightweight mentions
extras: Not yet on the official Community Plugins list; install manually or via BRAT for beta builds. The README documents that the suggester reads all vault markdown file names plus stub-file headings on every keystroke, and includes a table of plugin-review findings and their fixes. Known limitations include a single global stub file and exact-text heading matching for promotion.
motivation: The README opens: 'An Obsidian plugin for people who mention way more things than they want to turn into full notes.'
problem: Obsidian unresolved links point nowhere until a note is written, and creating a full note for every mentioned thing clutters the vault with files the user does not want to maintain.

relations.evidence: this plugin doesn't call Templater itself — it just writes the chosen template's raw text

summary: Trigger-character suggester that inserts mention links, parking unresolved ones as headings in a shared stub file until they are promoted to full notes.
